title.en: Ludwig — A passionate gamer of Earth Online
title.zh-Hant: Ludwig — 一個熱衷於探索地球 Online 的初級玩家
title.zh-Hans: Ludwig — 一个热衷于探索地球 Online 的初级玩家

text.en: An engineer who stays curious about Earth Online.
text.zh-Hant: 是一名對地球 Online 始終保持好奇的工程師
text.zh-Hans: 是一名对地球 Online 始终保持好奇的工程师

html.en:
Right now, my main focus is on machine learning and deep learning, alongside software development and distributed systems. Lately, I've also been diving into networking and cloud architecture. It might sound like I'm trying to take on too much, but to borrow Steve Jobs' words: "Stay hungry, stay foolish." For me, it's simply about chasing what I genuinely love.

The tech world feels like an endless treasure hunt. There's always a new problem to solve or a fresh perspective to discover. Of course, the sheer amount of information can be overwhelming at times, but that feeling when you finally grasp a tough concept or fix a complex bug? That is exactly why I keep falling in love with this field over and over again.

Beyond tech, I'm deeply curious about a variety of subjects, including biology, physics, history, and current affairs. I really enjoy the collision of ideas across different disciplines. It often provides a completely new lens through which to understand the world.

Outside of work, my lifestyle is pretty dynamic. I love watching baseball and esports, playing basketball, and staying active through fitness and swimming. I'm also a big fan of anime, TV series, and gaming. On top of that, I'm planning to challenge myself with drawing soon, and I'm looking to pick up the piano again after letting it slide for a while.

If you're also curious about the world or feel like we're on the same wavelength, definitely feel free to reach out. I'd love to connect!
html.zh-Hant:
目前我主要專注於機器學習、深度學習的理論與應用，以及軟體開發與分散式系統；未來也期待能持續深入探索網路與雲端架構。

我是真的很喜歡資訊領域，我覺得它最迷人的地方，就在於它是一座永遠挖不完的寶庫，總是藏著新的問題、觀點與可能性。雖然有時不免被龐大的資訊量淹沒而感到疲憊，但每當真正弄懂一個新概念、解開一個複雜問題時，那種無與倫比的成就感，總能讓我再次愛上這個領域。

除了資訊領域，我也對生物、物理、歷史、人文及時事抱持濃厚興趣。我很喜歡跨領域的知識碰撞，因為它們總會在意想不到的地方產生連結，帶給我更完整的視角來理解這個世界。

在工作與學習之外，我的生活也相當靈活多元。平常我喜歡看棒球、看電競、打籃球，也透過健身和游泳保持活力；同時，我也是動漫、影集和遊戲的愛好者。最近甚至正雄心壯志地計畫挑戰畫畫，並想把放下一陣子的鋼琴重新練回來。

如果你也對世界充滿好奇，或者剛好與我有相似的頻率，非常歡迎找我交流，也許我們會非常聊得來！

我是真的很喜欢信息领域，我觉得它最迷人的地方，就在于它是一座永远挖不完的宝库，总是藏着新的问题、观点与可能性。虽然有时不免被庞大的信息量淹没而感到疲惫，但每当真正弄懂一个新概念、解开一个复杂问题时，那种无与伦比的成就感，总能让我再次爱上这个领域。

cipherHtml.en:
Right now, I’m mostly into machine learning and deep learning, doing a lot of dev work and distributed systems. I’m also trying to learn more about networking and cloud architecture lately. It probably sounds like I’m trying to do way too much, but honestly? Like Steve Jobs said: "Stay hungry, stay foolish." To me, it’s just about chasing what I love.

The tech world is like a never-ending treasure hunt. There’s always a new problem to solve or a cool new perspective to look at. Yeah, the sheer amount of stuff to learn can be super overwhelming sometimes, but that feeling when you finally get a tough concept or fix a crazy bug? That’s why I keep falling in love with this stuff over and over again.

Outside of tech, I’m also super curious about a bunch of other things, like biology, physics, history, and just what’s happening in the world. I love it when ideas from completely different fields collide. It gives you a whole new way to look at life.

As for my free time, I’m pretty flexible. I love watching baseball and esports, playing basketball, hitting the gym, and swimming. I’m also a big fan of anime, TV shows, and gaming. Oh, and I’m actually planning to challenge myself with drawing soon, and I’m trying to pick up the piano again after letting it rust for a while.

If you’re curious about the world too, or if you feel like we’re on the same wavelength, definitely hit me up. I bet we’d get along great!
